name_reason: Compliant game-function name (fd2_ prefix). '1d' is the per-event handler table dispatch index (slot 0x1D), a legitimate domain ID, NOT an address residue -- the function lives at 0x34a3c. Confirmed slot 0x1D: table base 0x51B91, xref site 0x51c05, (0x51c05-0x51b91)/4 = 29 = 0x1D, and the entry bytes are 3c 4a 03 00 = 0x34a3c. '__unref' correctly reflects that no FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot. '_dialog_with_state' reflects the category (shows a dialog page then chains to the AI-state-clearing handler 0x1C). No address residue.
purpose: Unreferenced per-event handler dispatch slot 0x1D: shows chapter-text dialog page 2, then tail-chains to handler 0x1C (ch8 AI-control) forwarding the event arg.
logic_summary: Two-beat straight-line handler. (1) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) with the standard dialog geometry shared by every handler in this group. (2) fd2_chapter_event_handler_1c__ch8_ai_ctrl(event_arg) -- chains to the ch8 AI-control beat (which masks combat_aux_block[0xD] &= 0x80 for the 18 runtime-char slots 0x0A..0x1B). The incoming event_arg is forwarded unchanged via the original tail PUSH dword ptr [ESP+4]; CALL 0x34a0e; ADD ESP,4; RET (handler_1c ignores the value but the pass-through is byte-faithful). Compiler-injected __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue; EBX not touched. No RNG, no numeric computation, no branch, no CALL-return value consumed.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91. Forwarded unchanged to handler_1c (PUSH [ESP+4]); handler_1c ignores it, but this handler is the one sibling that does pass it through rather than discard it.
params.reason: Name accurately describes the value (the dispatch event argument) and carries no address residue. Matches the convention used across all sibling handlers in chevt1.c.
